title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Further Strengthening Judicial Statistics Work
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Further Strengthening Judicial Statistics Work

Fa Fa [2009] No. 55

To: the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To further strengthen the judicial statistics work of the people's courts, the Supreme People's Court has formulated the Opinions on Further Strengthening Judicial Statistics Work (hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions") to regulate the judicial statistics work. The Opinions clarify the importance of judicial statistics work under the new circumstances, emphasize the functional role of judicial statistics work, point out the direction for reform and development of judicial statistics work, and put forward requirements for strengthening the allocation of judicial statistics personnel and work guarantees. The Opinions are hereby issued to you for implementation in light of the actual work of the courts. The Supreme People's Court will inspect the implementation of the Opinions by the people's courts at all levels next year.

It is hereby notified.

November 23, 2009

Opinions on Further Strengthening Judicial Statistics Work

To further strengthen the judicial statistics work of the people's courts, promote the informatization, standardization, and institutionalization of judicial statistics work, continuously advance the reform of judicial statistics, strive to enhance the level of judicial statistics, and fully leverage the functional role of judicial statistics, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

I. Fully Recognize the Importance of Strengthening Judicial Statistics Work under the New Circumstances

1. Judicial statistics work is an important foundational work of the people's courts. Judicial statistics are an important basis for the people's courts to understand the situation of trial work, assess the operational态势 of trials, and summarize experiences in trial work. They are an important means for the people's courts to achieve scientific decision-making and scientific management. Strengthening judicial statistics work is of great significance for the people's courts to better grasp the overall work, advance court work, and promote scientific development.

2. In the new historical period, new situations and new problems in the trial work of the people's courts are constantly emerging. The responsibility to serve economic and social development and maintain social harmony and stability has become more significant. The task of continuously meeting the growing judicial needs of the people has become more arduous. There is an urgent need to further strengthen judicial statistics work, fully leverage the various functional roles of judicial statistics, and provide more comprehensive, accurate, and swift information services for trial work.

3. People's courts at all levels shall, from the perspective of thoroughly implementing the Scientific Outlook on Development, further enhance their understanding of the importance and urgency of strengthening judicial statistics work in the new era. They shall position judicial statistics work within the overall work of the people's courts and the全局 of trial work, effectively strengthen statistical awareness, reinforce statistical responsibilities, and focus on solving prominent problems in the systems and mechanisms of judicial statistics work, personnel allocation, informatization construction, and material guarantees. Further effective measures shall be taken to strive for the scientific development of judicial statistics work in the people's courts.

II. Further Leverage the Functional Role of Judicial Statistics Work

4. Strengthen the foundational work of judicial statistics. Implement the Statistics Law, improve various systems such as judicial statistics investigation, statistical consultation, and statistical supervision. Strengthen the management of all links including original records, collection, processing, transmission, storage, and utilization of statistical data. Ensure that judicial statistics data is comprehensive, objective, accurate, and timely. Ensure that judicial statistics work is standardized and orderly, laying a solid foundation for leveraging the functional role of judicial statistics.

5. Strengthen the analysis of judicial statistics. Pay close attention to changes in case data information. Use judicial statistics data as the main basis to strengthen the analysis of the operational态势 of trial work. Strengthen special analyses of new situations and new problems in trial work. Pay attention to summarizing trial experiences and put forward opinions and suggestions for improving trial work. Fully utilize judicial statistics data resources, combined with political and economic information closely related to trial activities. Actively explore the relationship between trial work and economic and social development changes. Predict case development trends. Provide statistical support for scientific decision-making by leaders, strengthening trial management, and improving legislation and judicial interpretation.

6. Expand the comprehensive utilization of judicial statistics achievements. Actively carry out case quality assessment work. Conduct in-depth research on a scientific and reasonable case quality assessment system. Correctly handle the relationship between case quality assessment, case quality review, and performance appraisal. Correctly handle the relationship between comprehensive assessment results and individual indicator data. Comprehensively and scientifically evaluate the trial work of the people's courts.

7. Establish a system for public release of judicial statistics data. Increase the transparency of judicial statistics information. Regularly hold press conferences on judicial statistics information. Actively explore the establishment of a white paper system for judicial statistics. Fully utilize media such as the internet and newspapers to timely disclose non-confidential judicial statistics information to the public, promoting openness in trials. Strictly comply with confidentiality systems and the review and approval system for public release of judicial statistics data. All statistical data related to trial work shall be uniformly provided by the statistical institutions of the people's courts at all levels, preventing data from multiple sources and ensuring the accuracy, seriousness, and authority of judicial statistics data.

III. Further Advance the Reform of Judicial Statistics Work

8. Strengthen the standardization construction of judicial statistics. The Supreme People's Court shall, based on the development and needs of the trial situation, strengthen theoretical research on judicial statistics, formulate unified national judicial statistics standards for the courts, improve the judicial statistics indicator system, and achieve standardization in the涵义, calculation methods, classification目录, and investigation forms of judicial statistics indicators, ensuring the scientificness and objectivity of judicial statistics.

9. Reform the methods of judicial statistics investigation. Change the judicial statistics investigation method, which mainly relies on comprehensive surveys, to one where comprehensive surveys, sample surveys, and key surveys are conducted in parallel. Conduct irregular surveys on public satisfaction, court image, and social effects of trials, providing references for leaders' decision-making and grasping trial dynamics.

10. Reform the methods of judicial statistics analysis. Explore general patterns of trials from judicial statistics data. Constantly pay attention to changes in case circumstances. Reflect problems through judicial statistics data, and also analyze problems in conjunction with political and economic information and social development. Conduct not only ex-post analysis but also strengthen pre-event analysis and in-process tracking analysis, comprehensively improving the depth and力度 of judicial statistics analysis.

11. Reform the model of judicial statistics. Establish a judicial statistics model with case information as the core and judicial statistics reports as important supplements. Integrate case information resources. Realize intelligent extraction and automated verification of case information. Eliminate falsification of statistical data. Prevent omission of data reporting and multiple-source statistics. Improve information feedback and transmission mechanisms. Promote the in-depth development of judicial statistics work.

12. Accelerate the informatization construction of judicial statistics. Establish a judicial statistics information network with dynamic tracking functions. Build a national court case information database. Courts at all levels shall incorporate the informatization construction of judicial statistics into the overall plan for court informatization construction. Define construction tasks, goals, and progress. Achieve the integration of the judicial statistics system with the case management system and the enforcement information system by the end of 2010. Change the situation where case information is not shared or compatible among different court departments and between higher and lower level courts.

IV. Further Strengthen the Construction of the Judicial Statistics Organization System

13. Strengthen the construction of judicial statistics work institutions. The Supreme People's Court and local people's courts at all levels shall establish judicial statistics institutions responsible for guiding and managing the judicial statistics work of their own courts and the courts within their jurisdiction. Judicial statistics institutions shall be established in the research offices. Where there is no research office, they shall be established in departments closely related to the judicial statistics business of the court. Implement a judicial statistics management system of unified guidance, centralized management, and graded responsibility. Intermediate people's courts and basic people's courts that do not yet have the conditions to establish judicial statistics institutions shall assign full-time judicial statistics personnel and designate a person responsible for judicial statistics. Strengthen the judicial statistics work of trial divisions and other departments within the people's courts. Unify口径, unify release, and unify coordination. Cooperate with the competent departments for judicial statistics in carrying out their work.

14. People's courts at all levels shall equip themselves with sufficient and capable judicial statistics personnel. Higher people's courts shall assign three or more full-time judicial statistics personnel. Intermediate people's courts and basic people's courts must assign full-time judicial statistics personnel. Trial divisions and people's tribunals of people's courts at all levels shall designate specific persons to be responsible for judicial statistics work. Since judicial statistics work involves state secrets, judicial statistics personnel shall be assigned in accordance with the requirements for personnel in confidential positions, be familiar with trial, statistics, and computer operations, and temporary employees shall not be used. The Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts shall establish a talent pool for judicial statistics, strengthening the training and use of high-quality, versatile judicial statistics talents.

15. People's courts at all levels shall take effective measures to ensure the stability of the judicial statistics team and the continuity of judicial statistics work. Care for the growth and progress of judicial statistics personnel. Full-time judicial statistics personnel who meet the conditions shall be included in the序列 of trial personnel, and enjoy the same treatment as trial personnel in terms of promotion, rank advancement, and evaluation and commendation. Judicial statistics personnel shall remain relatively stable and shall not be frequently replaced or transferred. When replacement or transfer is truly necessary, it shall be reported to the competent department of the higher people's court for filing, and timely training shall be provided to new judicial statistics personnel, with proper handover procedures.

16. Increase the intensity of training for judicial statistics personnel, especially those at the basic level. Strictly enforce the pre-job training system for judicial statistics personnel. New judicial statistics personnel shall not take up their posts without training. Intermediate people's courts and above shall conduct systematic and targeted judicial statistics training to improve the professional knowledge and skill levels of judicial statistics personnel, striving to build a judicial statistics team that is politically strong, professionally proficient, and willing to contribute.

V. Further Strengthen Guarantees for Judicial Statistics Work

17. Strengthen organizational guarantees for judicial statistics work. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen leadership over judicial statistics work. Incorporate judicial statistics work into the important agenda of court work. Regularly listen to reports on the situation of judicial statistics work. Effectively solve the practical difficulties and problems encountered in judicial statistics work. Support and ensure that statistical institutions and statisticians perform their duties in accordance with the law. Ensure the smooth progress of judicial statistics work and the timely and accurate completion of judicial statistics tasks. Actively promote statisticians to participate in or attend as non-voting participants relevant trial work meetings, enabling judicial statistics personnel to timely grasp court work deployments and better leverage the role of judicial statistics in decision-making consultation and supervision and management.

18. Strengthen material guarantees for judicial statistics work. Further increase investment. Effectively guarantee the necessary expenses for judicial statistics work. Strengthen the construction of software and hardware for judicial statistics work. Timely equip software products and hardware equipment that meet the requirements of statistical work and confidentiality regulations. Courts with the conditions shall, in accordance with confidentiality regulations, equip dedicated computer rooms and necessary facilities for judicial statistics computers.

19. Strengthen supervision and guidance over judicial statistics work. Through regular巡回 inspections, special inspections, categorized inspections, and other methods, strengthen the supervision and inspection of the judicial statistics work of lower-level people's courts and the statistical basic units within the court itself. Put forward improvement opinions for problems found and require rectification within a time limit. Handle units and individuals who violate statistical laws and regulations seriously in accordance with the law. Establish and improve the assessment system for judicial statistics work. Regularly notify assessment results and provide commendation and rewards. Timely summarize and promote experience in judicial statistics work. Play the role of typical examples. Further improve the overall level of judicial statistics work.
